mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
evidence_refs: fact:2008-2013 rate cuts coincided with 150% S&P 500 gain
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate decline below 7.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions, increasing consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2009-2013 UNRATE fell from 10% to 7.5% as S&P 500 rose 150%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when UNRATE < 7.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above 12-month moving averages indicate robust economic demand, sustaining positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2005-2007 GDP/housing growth preceded 100% S&P 500 rally
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed 12m_MA.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL monthly increase exceeding 0.2% signals accelerating inflation, triggering Fed rate hikes that reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:1979 inflation surge caused 25% S&P 500 drop in 6 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL increases >0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth above 135,000 thousand persons indicates sustained labor market strength, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2010-2013 payroll growth averaged 150k/month as S&P 500 rose 120%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when PAYEMS > 135,000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 95 (2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2008 INDPRO drop to 75 preceded 50% S&P 500 decline
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: Joint increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 12-month moving average and federal funds rate decline below 0.2% signals strong consumer demand and accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2010-2011 RSAFS rise + FEDFUNDS=0.15% caused 20% S&P 500 gain
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when RSAFS > 12m_MA and FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 895 thousand units signals housing market recovery, increasing consumer confidence and construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2012-2013 HOUST rose from 800k to 900k as S&P 500 rose 15%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when HOUST > 895.
